Costume Pokémon

46 costume Pokémon: caps, Halloween looks and where they turn up.

A costume Pokémon fights, levels and counts in the Pokédex as its normal species; it only changes how it looks. It gets its own page in the Stamp book (every costume in normal, ★, ◆, ✦ and ♛). A costumed Pokémon only evolves if its evolution has the costume too.

  • Wild guests: each 6-hour window has one guest costume that can visit your Mass Outbreak islands (1 in 400 encounters there).
  • Costume outbreak: one window a day, a Halloween costume while Spooky season is open (until November 9), or one of the 5 Golden Leaf costumes during the Golden Leaf Festival (November 14 to November 28). It's on one of the first 4 islands, at the top of everyone's outbreak list.
  • Bounties: while Spooky season is open, every bounty board hands out the Halloween costumes as guaranteed encounters on its easiest bounties.
  • Costume Eggs: from Stamp book prizes, Tower milestones (floors 25 / 50 / 75 / 100) and, rarely, friend gifts.
  • Breeding: until 09 Nov 2026, a parent in a Halloween costume passes it on to the baby.
  • The first time you meet a costume in a look you don't have, it's always worth a ball; a prize encounter that gets away comes back.
